mailer_templates_confirmation_content:
Confirm your Nutrition.Fitness account

Enter this code on the Nutrition.Fitness page where you created your account:

{{ .Token }}

The code expires in 10 minutes and can be used once.

If you did not create this account, you can ignore this email.
mailer_templates_recovery_content:
Reset your Nutrition.Fitness password

Enter this code on the Nutrition.Fitness page where you requested a password reset:

{{ .Token }}

The code expires in 10 minutes and can be used once. After verification, choose your new password on the website.

If you did not request this reset, you can ignore this email. Your password has not changed.
mailer_templates_magic_link_content:
Your Nutrition.Fitness sign-in code

Enter this code on the Nutrition.Fitness sign-in page:

{{ .Token }}

The code expires in 10 minutes and can be used once.

If you did not request this code, you can ignore this email.
